import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import Counter
def areas(g):
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
    # bounding box per color
    bb={}; rows=[r for r in g]; 
    for c in cnt:
        rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(rows) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        cs=[j for i,r in enumerate(rows) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rr=[i for i,r in enumerate(rows) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs=set(rr); cs=set(cs)
        bb[c]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return bb

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

print('rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs))

def rects(g,verbose=False):
    R=[]
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs=[i for i,_ in cells]; cs=[j for _,j in cells]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        ok=all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1))
        R.append((h*w,c,min(rs),min(cs),h,w,ok,len(cells)))
    return sorted(R,reverse=True,key=lambda x:x[0])
